title: Store codes with UPPER and LOWER
objective: Use UPPER and LOWER to put codes into one standard case, then look up each store's region.
instructions: Store codes in column A were typed in mixed case. In B2:B6, show each code in capitals with UPPER. In C2:C6, show each code in lower case with LOWER. In D2:D6, look up the standard code from column B in the store list in F1:G6 with XLOOKUP and show the text "Unknown" when the code is not in the list. Fix the store list with $ signs.
hints: UPPER(text) turns every letter into a capital and LOWER(text) into a small letter. Digits and hyphens do not change. =UPPER(A2) gives NBO-01 for nbo-01.
Use UPPER in column B and LOWER in column C, both pointing at the original code in column A.
For the region, look up the standard code in B2: =XLOOKUP(B2,$F$2:$F$6,$G$2:$G$6,"Unknown"). Fix the list ranges with $ signs.
